newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO STOCKS END HIGHER, FUJI TV MAKES GOOD DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO STOCKS END HIGHER, FUJI TV MAKES GOOD DEBUT.

text.p: Tokyo stocks reversed early losses to close modestly higher on Friday, supported by a technical rebound and a recovery in construction shares, brokers said.
The highlight of the day was Fuji Television Network Inc's successful debut on the market, they said.
The 225-share Nikkei average gained 128.61 points or 0.66 percent to close at 19,604.46. It had fallen as low as 19,256.13. Its September futures finished 310 points higher at 19,680.
